Not repeated per row: RuntimeError from a C-stack overflow (MP_STACK_CHECK) is I.4(d.1)'s design defect, recorded by report_if_fatal() in the handler that catches it, never a per-site raise. A call never raises for its frame (py/objfun.c:268-287 falls back to the C stack); `super().m()` compiles to LOAD_SUPER_METHOD (py/emitbc.c:536) with the super object on the C stack (py/objtype.c:1425-1426), so no super() call or allocation is left of it; an exception object falls back to the emergency object and an empty or emergency tuple (py/objexcept.c:209-240), so constructing one never raises. Small fixed allocations: an async def call's generator (py/objgenerator.c:53-66), a *args call's tuple, asyncio's Task and Lock/Event generators; F.2 sends these to I.4(a): a function doomed without memory does not catch. On a run-time path the calling task ends and _log_dead_task()'s except Exception (asy_system_service.py:326) persists it, after which the supervisor restarts the task (I.4(c)); at construction (FRAMManager and FRAM_SPI are built inside build_system()) and in FRAMManager.setup() (run_setups() catches nothing, asy_system_service.py:738-744) the raise ends asyncio.run(main()), where the generated boot entry's except BaseException (build/generated_src/sensortask_<device>_main.py:38, buildgen/codegen.py:867) records the loop end and leaves the armed watchdog to reset. asyncio.CancelledError is a BaseException (extmod/asyncio/core.py:18): no `except Exception` here swallows a cancel, and every await may deliver one, which propagates to the canceller by design. Calls into asy_base_classes, asy_print_log and math_helpers that the walk marks transitive take those modules' own rows and are not repeated here. The chunk layer runs in the calling task: a logger's persistence (asy_print_log.py:321, :354, in whichever task logs), the SGP40 backup (asy_sgp40_driver.py:512, :558) and the shutdown sequence's erase and quiesce (asy_system_service.py:464, :483), inside the shutdown sequence's try (asy_system_service.py:445, except Exception :498). get_chunk()/get_timestamped_chunk() run at construction only: their callers catch MemoryError (asy_print_log.py:292-294, asy_sgp40_driver.py:242-246) and the generated boot entry's except BaseException (build/generated_src/sensortask_<device>_main.py:38, buildgen/codegen.py:867) holds the rest.
